title: 1.5.0 delta update silently corrupts any install more than one version behind
description: P0, Fabio 2026-09-08. apply-update.cjs validates only appId and never reads manifest.fromVersion, so the 1.4.4->1.5.0 delta applies onto a 1.3.0 install and reports success. 67 files added during 1.4.x are left missing; the server is healthy and the RENDERER dies on a missing ESM import, which reads as a hang. Fresh installs and 1.4.4 users are unaffected. Fix: ship 1.5.1 as a FULL bundle (self-heals everyone) plus a fromVersion guard. Root cause + evidence: brief.md.
